newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 12.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's edition of Daily Variety:
NEW YORK - Although the box-office success of the movie "Independence Day" has helped increase operating earnings at News Corp, it was not enough to prevent a drop in the company's net income.
